request.prompt: gualaar: The Gualaar was an ungulate species indigenous to the mountains and hills of the planet Naboo. These creatures though tricky to domesticate had both the build and strength to make them perfect beasts of burden. The Royal House of Naboo kept a herd of Gualaar that were used to carry state officials. This regal affiliation and their physical practicality meant they were exported and ultimately spread across multiple worlds. It's similarity in appearance to the legendary Thrumbo is a point of interest amongst several xenobiologists. The head carries one massive cream-ivory horn sweeping up and back from the crown, plus two small ivory horns on the snout, turning consistently in every facing. The body is a tall, massive, broad-barrelled Thrumbo-like quadruped on thick pillar legs with broad heavy feet, a long upright neck and a long tail. The coat is short, even white to off-white fur, with cream-ivory horns and black eyes. The silhouette echoes the vanilla Thrumbo: a heavy white beast with a single dominant horn. The rendering is painterly, with a thin dark outline and realistic modelled fur and musculature. Painterly vanilla RimWorld style, realistic, clean dark outline, transparent background.
